analysis.pricePatternEn: 5-day low < 20-day low, 5-day high < 20-day high → Lower High formation
analysis.reason: 직전 4거래일 연속 하락세, RSI 43.6으로 과매도 구간 진입. ADX 14.5로 추세 형성 미약. 5일 저가 < 20일 저가, 5일 고가 < 20일 고가 패턴으로 Lower High 형성. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 2.10으로 급증하며 하락세에 힘 실림. 현재가 $941.78은 스윙 지지선 $921.53에 근접.
analysis.reasonEn: Previous 4 trading days showed a downtrend. RSI entered oversold territory at 43.6. ADX at 14.5 indicates weak trend formation. Price pattern formed a Lower High with 5-day low < 20-day low and 5-day high < 20-day high. Volume ratio of 2.10 (vs 5-day average) surged, supporting the downtrend. Current price $941.78 is near the swing support at $921.53.

analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI is neutral at 48.5, but daily oversold signal takes precedence.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (9.2821→0.1736): 약세 수렴 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 미약

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Lower High): 하락 추세 지속 진단
[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($941.78) vs SMA5/20/50 ($989.34/$971.41/$967.25): Diagnosing short-term/mid-term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($995.52/$930.66): Diagnosing weak mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (61.8%) + Current price level at historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (56.7→43.6): Diagnosing entry into oversold territory + maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (9.2821→0.1736): Diagnosing bearish convergence + weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $915.88): Approaching lower band + band width at 11.43% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($921.53): Support based on Pivot S1 ($891.28).
· Swing resistance ($948.38): Potential for short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High): Diagnosing continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.10x): Increasing reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Conditions for entry: Confirmation of RSI recovery above 50 and MACD histogram improvement.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 고가/저가 패턴이 20일 고가/저가 패턴보다 낮아 Lower High 형성, 하락 추세 지속 가능성 시사.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The 5-day high/low pattern is lower than the 20-day high/low pattern, forming a Lower High and suggesting potential continuation of the downtrend.
keyPoints: RSI 43.6으로 과매도 구간 진입, 5일 연속 하락세 마감 가능성
ADX 14.5로 추세 미형성, 충격성 변동 가능성 내포
keyPointsEn: RSI at 43.6 entering oversold territory, possibility of ending 5-day consecutive decline.
ADX at 14.5 indicates no trend formation, implying potential for shock-like volatility.
Volume ratio surged to 2.10, adding momentum to the downtrend.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 14.5로 추세 미형성 구간에서 발생하는 급락은 추세적 붕괴가 아닌 충격성 변동으로 해석해야 함.
analysis.riskNoteEn: Sharp declines in an ADX below 20 (no trend formation) should be interpreted as shock-like volatility rather than a trend breakdown.
analysis.continuity: 직전 4거래일 관망 판독 유지. 금일 RSI 과매도 진입 및 거래량 급증으로 관망 유지.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 4 trading days. Today's RSI entering oversold and surging volume support maintaining the wait-and-see approach.
